_comment: Fixed base buffs of skills that live in mutator code (not in the skill tree). Only values read from code/constants (Ghidra pseudo-C + ISIL + tools/readconst.py), schema in docs/ENGINE.md §9.7. Keys = AbilityInfo.abilityName; keys starting with _ are ignored. Entry `source` is documentation only. Checked WITHOUT a hard-coded numeric buff in code (nothing to model here): Warcry (Berserk 4.0 is a tree node), Rebuke (-80% damage taken is not in code), Arcane Ascendance, Flame Ward, Death Seal, Eterra's Blessing, Healing Hands, Ring of Shields, Manifest Armor, Smoke Bomb, Fury Leap, forms (Spriggan, Swarmblade, Werebear, Reaper), Focus, Dread Shade, Sacrifice, Transplant, Teleport (all numbers come from tree fields, AbilityProperty or prefab data). Their tree buffs go through field_models.json (scope global).

Holy Aura.note: Aura on caster and allies; M = 1 + effect bonus (AbilityProperty holyAura #0, for Paladin — "Covenant of Light"); enhanced cast ×2

Symbols of Hope.note: Each symbol (up to 3 + additional, +1 every 2 s) grants the caster and allies in the area stat × number of symbols × M (M = 1 + sigilsOfHopeIncreasedEffect, for Paladin "Covenant of Light"). Activation spends all symbols: for 3 s −5% damage taken per symbol (+100 ward per symbol, ward is not modelled), the passive symbol stats disappear. Conversion to lightning, "Self Only" etc. (tree nodes) are not counted; the tree list statsToGrant goes through field_models.json without M.
Symbols of Hope.uptime: symbols constantly (generation 1 every 2 s, limit 3); activation 3 s

active_input.label: Symbols of Hope: activation (3 s after spending symbols)

stats.label: less damage taken per spent symbol
stats.source: SigilsOfHopeActiveMutator.Mutate: MoreStat(SP 6 DamageTaken, sigils × [0x18471CEF4] = -0.05 × (1 − AbilityProperty #9)); not applied when canCastDivineFlare

ability_properties.label: health regen from symbol (sigilsOfHopeAddedHealthRegen)
ability_properties.source: SigilsOfHopeMutator.Mutate: AddedStat(SP 17, mgr+0x132c) via AddStatToAura (× symbols × M)

Enchant Weapon.source: EnchantWeaponPassiveMutator..ctor and EnchantWeaponMutator..ctor (Stat 0x280 more), EnchantWeaponMutator.Mutate (BuffCreatorOnCreation, duration)
Enchant Weapon.note: Passive (always while skill on bar): 15% more damage (Elemental|Melee). Activation: 50% more same stat, replaces passive (one buff name), lasts (1 + inc) × (5 s + added) with 15 s cooldown. Field activeStatsMultiplier = 3.0 in Mutate not read. Tree lists: passive and active (there values ×2).
Enchant Weapon.uptime: passive always; active 5 s from 15 s cooldown

active_input.label: Enchant Weapon: activation (5 s after cast)

stats.label: bonus enchantment on weapon
stats.source: EnchantWeaponPassiveMutator..ctor: Stat(0, 0x280, more = [0x18471CD50] = 0.15); EnchantWeaponMutator..ctor: more = [0x184561C04] = 0.5; +0x148 duration 5.0 (0x40A00000)

Firebrand.source: FirebrandMutator.ModifyFirebrandStacks (AddedStat 5.0 at [0x18456202C]), FirebrandMutator.ApplyStackToPlayer, max stacks (4 + addedMaxStacks)
Firebrand.note: Each stack of Firebrand (4 s × (1 + inc), maximum 4 + additional) grants player +5 added fire damage melee. Conversion to lightning (node) changes tag to Melee|Lightning, not counted; spell damage per stack and other stack stats — in field_models.json.
Firebrand.uptime: 4 s per stack, stacks refreshed by hits; input — number of stacks

Aura Of Decay.source: AuraOfDecayMutator.Mutate (MoreStat(SP 6, AT 0x1040, [0x18471CEA0]) into the BuffCreator stats; ISIL lines 11722-11741)
Aura Of Decay.note: While the aura is on (skill toggle): −30% poison damage taken (DamageTaken more, DoT|Poison). Aura conversion (nodes) changes the tag to DoT|Cold / DoT|Physical / DoT|Fire, not counted. Skill properties #1 (Damage increased Poison), #14 (more DoT), #15 (more DoT taken) are missing from the passive data.

Dark Quiver.note: Next bow attack after picking up black arrow: +100% increased damage (in code tag empty; Bow tag added because arrows spend only bow skills). This is conditional stat of specific attack, not permanent buff: input enables it for entire evaluation.
Dark Quiver.uptime: one attack per picked up arrow

stats.label: damage of next bow attack (black arrow)
